name: Spanish Common Words Set 10
description: This set is part of a larger collection focused on frequently used Spanish words, including a mix of nouns, verbs, adjectives, and other essential parts of speech.

cards.sentence: Debemos apoyar a nuestra comunidad en tiempos difíciles.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We must support our community in difficult times.

cards.sentence: Necesito firmar este contrato antes de enviarlo.
